title: The Heart of Eldoria
author: Rowan Silverthorn
description: An enchanted ancient forest is succumbing to shadow blight. Choose between harvesting a sacred sun relic, waking a dormant stone colossus, or making an ultimate warden sacrifice.

scenes.title: The Withered Crossroads
scenes.content: Silver-barked trees weep violet sap as a creeping blight coils around their roots. You stand as a Warden of the Veil at a fork in the path. To your left, an overgrown brook trickles toward the Sunken Shrine of Dawn. To your right, thorny brambles veil a dormant stone sentinel.

choices.text: Follow the stream toward the Sunken Shrine of Dawn
Venture into the thorny Hollow of Brambles

scenes.title: The Sunken Shrine of Dawn
scenes.content: Partially submerged beneath crystal-clear spring water lies a carved marble lotus. Resting within its petals is the Sunstone of Eldoria, pulsating with warm, golden solar radiance that repels the encroaching gloom.

choices.text: Wade into the pool and retrieve the Sunstone
Leave the waters and explore the Hollow of Brambles
Hurry directly to the Heart of the World Tree

scenes.title: The Sunken Shrine (Relic Attuned)
scenes.content: The Sunstone hums warmly in your palm, casting a sphere of sunlight that drives back the creeping purple blight. Ahead, a sun-dappled ridge ascends directly to the World Tree.

choices.text: Ascend toward the World Tree with the Sunstone
Cross over to check on the Hollow of Brambles

scenes.title: The Hollow of Brambles
scenes.content: Tangled thorny vines constrict a moss-covered stone golem. The Sylvan Guardian's carved runic eyes flicker feebly as the shadow-thorns drain its earthen life force.

choices.text: Draw your warden blade and sever the shadow-vines
Turn toward the Sunken Shrine to seek an ancient relic
Bypass the stone giant and rush to the World Tree

scenes.title: The Awakened Colossus
scenes.content: With a low grinding of granite, the vines fall away. The Sylvan Guardian rises to its full ten-foot stature, runic symbols glowing emerald green. It bows its massive stone head in gratitude and prepares to follow your command.

choices.text: March alongside the Guardian toward the World Tree

scenes.title: The Heart of the World Tree
scenes.content: You reach the colossal trunk of the World Tree. Embedded directly into its ancient bark is a jagged obelisk of void crystal, pulsating with malevolent blight. The forest's pulse is growing fainter with every heartbeat.

choices.text: Channel the Sunstone's concentrated solar beam into the void crystal
Command the Sylvan Guardian to shatter the obelisk with its granite fists
Infuse your own warden soul into the roots to seal the blight in a protective barrier

scenes.title: The Golden Dawn
scenes.content: Golden rays erupt from the Sunstone, shattering the void crystal into harmless sparkling dust. Pure emerald sap surges through the World Tree, and wildflowers carpet the canopy in vibrant colors. Eldoria is reborn.

ending.title: The Golden Bloom
ending.description: You healed Eldoria with the ancient Sunstone, ushering in a brilliant new golden age.

scenes.title: Wrath of the Stone Warden
scenes.content: The Sylvan Guardian charges with a thunderous roar, slamming both fists into the void crystal until it crumbles to ash. The giant kneels before the roots, binding its eternal essence as the vigilant protector of the grove.

ending.title: The Sylvan Bastion
ending.description: Your compassion awakened an ancient ally whose strength liberated the forest.

scenes.title: The Twilight Slumber
scenes.content: Without sacred relic or ancient guardian, you place your palms against the bark and channel your own life essence. An amber protective cocoon envelops the heartwood. The blight is frozen in time, and the forest enters a peaceful slumber until a new warden rises.

ending.title: The Warden's Slumber
ending.description: You halted the corruption through pure devotion, leaving the forest safely dormant.
